notes: Approximate values chosen before this diagnostic at the user's request; not formal release thresholds.
Pending means the sampled sum of QueuePacket submitted minus completed on one scheduler node, including all eight packet types.
Each enumerated adapter is reported separately; possible aliases are never summed.
The observer does not measure a hardware queue depth or unsampled peak. Missing, reset, wrapped or ambiguous counters fail closed.
Room-release observation starts five seconds after observed leave and ends at requested export.
Continuous lossless ETW now supplies the settled-release window; active WDDM all-node samples remain required.
ETW packet limits are approximate diagnostic values too; scheduler packets are not hardware queue depth.
